summary.intent: Get PR #578 (change callisto/186, release publish isolation) through review: fix two blocking findings, push, resolve them, then merge latest origin/main after #582 and others merged, and prepare for the token-mapping PR.
summary.outcome: Both blocking findings were fixed, mutation-tested, pushed (sha 9cb8496c) and resolved on callisto/186. The origin/main merge was started: a conflict in docs/architecture/release.md was resolved via a script and a merge commit attempted, but the post-merge gates, push, ls-remote check and sha report were not yet done.

repo: Release tooling has a hidden `callisto release package-cargo` subcommand that runs one `cargo package --locked` per owning Cargo workspace, reusing error codes E308 and E309.
Scoped npm tarball names carry a 12-char SHA-256 prefix so `@acme/lib` and `acme-lib` stay distinct through pack, seal and publish.
Release workflow templates and this repo's own workflow must be kept in agreement with policy rules; merges from main (#576, #577, #581, #582) require rechecking this.
Gates are run via `just pre-push`, `lint`, `doc-check`, `test`, `ci`, and success is judged by exit code.
Mutation testing uses `cargo mutants --in-place --in-diff <diff> --test-tool nextest` with debug info disabled and 4 jobs to speed it up.
Two mutants remain as known equivalents: `ReleasePackageCargoReport` schema_version -> 1 and an empty-slice `Vec::leak`.
Findings are resolved with `entire trail finding resolve callisto/186 <id> -m <msg>`; commits are signed, and pushes use an explicit refspec followed by ls-remote verification.

code.finding: Merge conflict region between #582's `targets`/`asset-name` and forge-inference wording and this branch's pack, seal, package-cargo and publish text; both sides must be kept.

workflow: Verify pushes by comparing `git rev-parse HEAD` against `git ls-remote` for the explicit refspec.
Merge main without rebase or force-push when the lead requests it.
Long-running mutation runs go in the background with output logged to a file, then are inspected via grep for MISSED/TIMEOUT.
Report what was not re-run (e.g. `just ci` after the test-only second commit) rather than implying full coverage.

friction: #578 conflicted with main in docs/architecture/release.md after #582 merged.
The `just ci` run was not repeated after the second commit, leaving a small verification gap.
The recorded modified file (README.md) does not match the release.md conflict resolution, so the merge's file changes are unclear from the transcript.
open_items: Run just pre-push, lint, doc-check, test and ci on the merged tree, push with an explicit refspec, check ls-remote and report the sha.
Check that release workflow templates and policy rules still agree after #576, #577, #581 and #582 merged.
Verify the merge commit was created and signed; the transcript does not show the output.
Start the token-mapping PR after #578 merges, keeping it up to date with main before pushing.
Still unverified: generated workflows on real GitHub Actions, the `yarn` and `bun` pack flags, and anything against real registries.
The hidden `release package-cargo` subcommand is permanent surface area, flagged to the lead.
